body:
Follow-up to `selfrep-terminalmarket` (track 1): refines the DP fleet grid from 100 to 1,600 points and compares two interpolation rules. Policy value converges to about 0.15%; the table value approaches it from below roughly as 1/grid points. The hypothesis that linear-in-n interpolation removes the bias is not supported (reported as negative). Stylised, preliminary; no real-system claims.

Checks: 4 unit tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added.
